description: Read how the proposal of a campaign the caller's organization owns would reach its creators, as the web app shows it before request_campaign_send. reach maps the profileId of each match get_campaign lists to email and payoutCountry. email is published when Starcovery holds an address the creator published, researched when it holds only an address found by web research, and none when it holds no address. payoutCountry is supported when the profile country is one Starcovery pays out to, outside when it is not, and unknown when the profile names no country; a payout goes to the country of the creator's payout account, which can differ from the profile country. A campaign with no matches reads as an empty reach. A campaign of another organization reads as not found. Needs a credential.
name: get_campaign_send_reach
title: Get proposal send reach
